Cat Gomoku Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 23, 2026

TeamCP operates Cat Gomoku for Android (com.teamcp.catgomoku). You can play as a guest without signing up. We do not collect a name, email, phone number or Google password for our own registration. Depending on the features you choose, the game uses Google Play Games, Firebase online matches, Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads.

1. Scope

TeamCP operates Cat Gomoku for Android (com.teamcp.catgomoku). You can play as a guest without signing up. We do not collect a name, email, phone number or Google password for our own registration. Depending on the features you choose, the game uses Google Play Games, Firebase online matches, Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads.

2. Information on your device

The app stores your guest identifier, match record, puzzle/challenge/tower progress, achievements, currency, cats and cosmetic unlocks/selections, reward history, language, audio and vibration settings in private Android app storage. Usage analysis and diagnostic logs are local implementations and are not sent to an external analytics or automatic crash-reporting server. Ad consent is stored as a device setting and excluded from Google Play Games Saved Games.

Android auto backup is allowed, so app data may be included in Android backups depending on your device and Google account settings. The exclusion of ad consent from cloud saves refers to Google Play Games Saved Games, not an exclusion from Android backup.

3. Google Play Games connection

Connecting Google Play Games is optional. Google may process authentication status, player identifier and display name. Match records, puzzle/challenge progress, currency, cat/cosmetic unlocks, settings, achievement completion and incremental progress may be sent to Saved Games and achievements to provide cross-device saving/restoration and achievements.

4. Online 1:1 matches

Choosing online matches uses Google Firebase anonymous authentication and Realtime Database. It may process anonymous UID, display name, selected cat, Elo rating, tier, wins/losses/draws and ranking, matchmaking state, room identifier, move coordinates, connection status, match results and processing times. Purposes are matchmaking, real-time synchronization, result settlement, rankings and abuse prevention.

5. Ads and data processing

Unity LevelPlay mediates ads supplied by Unity Ads and ironSource (an ad network in Unity LevelPlay mediation): banner, interstitial and optional rewarded ads. Providers may process IP address and approximate region, device model, OS/app version, language, network information, permitted advertising/device identifiers, ad requests, impressions, clicks, viewing completion and ad error/diagnostic data. Purposes are ad delivery, frequency limits, measurement, fraud prevention and personalized ads if you agree. Actual processing depends on region, Android settings, consent and provider policies.

6. Your ad consent choice

On first launch every user sees the app’s own consent card and chooses personalized ads or only non-personalized ads. Before a choice, the ad SDK is not started and no ads are requested. Declining personalization does not reduce the number of ads; it sends LevelPlay a consent refusal and sale/sharing opt-out signal (do_not_sell=true). You can choose again in Settings at any time and control advertising ID/privacy in Android settings. Rewarded viewing is optional, and failure to load ads is designed not to block game progress.

7. Issue reports

To submit a report, write a description in Settings > “Report a problem / Contact” and tap Send. The app does not send automatic crash reports. A report contains the following information.

  • The description you write (up to 2,000 characters) and the report type you pick
  • Attached automatically: app identifier and version, the name of the screen you reported from, app language, device model name, and a random report number created for each report

If a report cannot be sent, it is stored on your device and may be retried when the connection returns.

Reports never include your advertising ID, an account, your game records or your location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the description. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on a report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to find and fix problems. The server and the hosting company may process your IP address in connection logs while the request is handled. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from the day they are received and then deleted.

8. Providers and international processing

Google Play Games provides optional login, cloud saves and achievements; Google Firebase provides anonymous authentication, online matches and rankings; Unity LevelPlay / Unity Ads / ironSource provides ad mediation, delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. Each provider may retain or process data abroad under its policy. TeamCP does not sell user information. See Unity’s policy for advertising rights and sale/sharing opt-out procedures.

Detailed notice of overseas transfers (added November 23, 2026)

Under Articles 28-8 and 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), we list each kind of processing in this game in which personal information is transferred outside Korea. The information below is sent directly from your device to each provider without passing through any server operated by TeamCP. Provider details are based on each provider’s published policy.

Ads — Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, ironSource Ads

Recipient and contact
Unity Technologies (Unity Technologies S.F.) — operator of Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads and ironSource Ads
Contact: DPO@unity3d.com · 116 New Montgomery Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States
Destination countries
The United States, plus countries where Unity has facilities (including Israel, where ironSource is headquartered) and countries with data centers of service providers Unity uses (such as Google Cloud Platform) — as stated in Unity’s Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
Data transferred
Advertising identifiers (Google advertising ID, app set ID, etc., to the extent device settings allow), IP address and approximate location derived from it, device model, operating system, app version, language, network information, and ad request, impression, click, completed-view, error and diagnostic information (details in the ads section of this policy)
When and how
Each time the ad SDK initializes or requests, shows or measures an ad while the app is running, sent directly from your device to Unity’s servers over the internet (encrypted connection)
Purpose
Ad mediation and delivery, frequency capping, performance measurement, fraud prevention, error diagnosis
Retention period
Unity states that it keeps data for as long as needed for the processing purposes and may keep it longer when needed for legal obligations or for disputes or investigations (Unity policy section 10, “Retention”). Because Unity does not publish a fixed retention period for general ad data, this policy does not state a separate period.
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to perform the contract for providing a free (ad-supported) game, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy
How to refuse and effect
If you turn off the internet connection, no ad requests or transfers take place. If you delete the advertising ID in Android settings, the advertising ID is not sent. If you do not want any transfer, you can stop using and uninstall the app; in that case you cannot use ads or ad rewards. To access or delete information already transferred, contact Unity (DPO@unity3d.com) or use the privacy icon in the ad.

Google — Google Play Games

Recipient and contact
Google LLC
Contact: googlekrsupport@google.com · Domestic representative in Korea: Google Korea LLC (22F, 152 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul · +82-2-722-7778 · data-access-requests@google.com) — as stated in Google’s “Additional privacy information for Korean residents”
Destination countries
Google data centers outside Korea (such as the United States). See Google data center locations for where they are.
Data transferred
Google Play Games: Sign-in status, player identifier and display name, saved game (match record, puzzle and challenge progress, currency, cat and appearance unlocks, settings), and achievement unlocks and incremental progress
When and how
Sent to Google over the network (encrypted connection) at the same time the information is collected, when the feature is used (per Google)
Purpose
Optional sign-in, save and restore across devices, achievements
Retention period
Google account and Play Games data are kept until you delete them or for the period Google sets (“Retaining your information” in Google’s Privacy Policy).
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to provide the game-linked features you choose, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy
How to refuse and effect
Nothing is sent if you do not connect Google Play Games, and you can still use the core game such as AI matches and puzzles. In that case you cannot save and restore across devices or use achievements. Saved data can be deleted with the Google Play data delete option in the app settings or through your Google account data controls.

Online 1:1 matches — Google Firebase (anonymous authentication, Realtime Database)

Recipient and contact
Google LLC (Firebase) — Firebase support · googlekrsupport@google.com · Domestic representative in Korea: Google Korea LLC (same as the Google entry above)
Destination countries
Anonymous authentication: United States (Firebase states that Authentication is processed only in US data centers) · Match database: Singapore (the Realtime Database location the app uses is asia-southeast1)
Data transferred
Anonymous UID, display name, chosen cat, Elo rating, tier, wins, losses, draws and ranking, matchmaking status, room identifier, move coordinates, connection status, match results and processing times (same as section 4)
When and how
Sent in real time over the internet (encrypted connection) while you choose online play and are matched or playing
Purpose
Matchmaking, real-time synchronization, result settlement, rankings, fraud prevention
Retention period
Profile, rating and match data are kept in TeamCP’s Firebase project as long as needed for online features and fraud prevention, and are deleted on request (section 9). Firebase states that it keeps IP addresses in authentication logs for a few weeks, and IP addresses and user agents for the database for a few days.
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to provide the online matches you choose, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy
How to refuse and effect
Nothing is sent if you do not use online play. In that case you cannot use online matches or rankings, but you can keep playing AI matches and puzzles. You can ask for stored information to be deleted using the contact below.

The following processing takes place in Korea and is not an overseas transfer.

  • Problem reports: reports you send yourself are stored on the report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea) and are not transferred abroad.

9. Retention and data deletion

Delete device data with the app’s data reset, Android Clear app data, or uninstalling. Manage Google Play Games data with the app’s Google Play data deletion and Google account controls; Google’s retention policy applies. Firebase profiles, ratings and match information are kept as needed for online features and abuse prevention; contact us to request deletion. Unity’s retention/deletion policies and rights procedures apply to ad data; uninstalling alone does not delete data already processed by ad providers. Send your app name and request, never passwords or identity documents.

Reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and, if possible, part of the text), and we will find and delete it.

10. Your rights

Guest single-player does not require Google Play Games or online matches. Contact teamcp.channel@gmail.com to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or consent withdrawal as available in your region. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will direct you to the provider’s procedure.

11. Children

The game is not designed specifically for children; its current store target audience is age 13 and over. Content ratings do not designate a child-directed service. The ad service is told that the app is not child-directed. If we learn that we directly collected a child’s personal information without required guardian consent, we take appropriate steps including deletion.

12. Security and policy changes

Local data stays in private Android app storage. Google Play Games, Firebase and ad services use their providers’ secure communication methods; service access and Firebase security rules are limited as needed. We update this policy and date when information, providers or features change and announce important changes in the app, store or this page.

Third-party policies

Additional notice under Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (added November 23, 2026)

Under Article 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and Article 31 of its Enforcement Decree, this notice explains your rights and how to exercise them, children under 14 and their legal guardians, the security measures we take, and our privacy officer. It applies together with the rest of this policy.

Your rights and how to exercise them

  • You may at any time ask TeamCP to give you access to, correct, delete, or suspend the processing of the personal information it processes about you, and you may withdraw your consent (PIPA Articles 35–37).
  • How to ask: email the app name and your request to the contact below (teamcp.channel@gmail.com). Because the app has no accounts, please include information that lets TeamCP find the record (for example, the approximate date or report number of a problem report). A legal guardian or a person you authorize may also make a request; in that case we may ask for proof of that relationship.
  • Response time: we will tell you the outcome within 10 days of receiving your request. If the law gives a reason to limit or refuse the request, or we cannot complete it within that time, we will tell you why and how to object.
  • Information stored only on your device (app records, settings, and so on) is not held by TeamCP, so you can delete it yourself with the app’s delete options, by clearing the app’s storage in Android settings, or by uninstalling the app.
  • For information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google, you can also contact each provider at the contact listed in the overseas transfer notice above.
  • Remedies in Korea: you can apply for dispute mediation or advice to the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (+82-1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr), the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, privacy.kisa.or.kr), the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office (1301, www.spo.go.kr), or the Korean National Police Agency (182, ecrm.police.go.kr).

Children under 14 and legal guardians

  • Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act requires the consent of a legal guardian when the personal information of a child under 14 is processed on the basis of consent (Article 22-2).
  • This app does not ask for a date of birth or age, and it has no age check or way to confirm a guardian’s consent. Because it does not treat users differently by age, the processing described in this policy also applies to users under 14. The app tells the ad services, at app level, that it is “not directed to children”. This is not the result of checking any individual user’s age.
  • Personalized ads: on first launch the app asks whether to allow personalized ads and does not start the ad SDK until you choose. Users under 14 should not allow personalized ads and should choose the non-personalized option. If personalized ads were already allowed, you can change this in the app settings.
  • Users under 14 should not include personal information such as their name or contact details in problem reports or inquiries.
  • Guardians’ rights and how to exercise them: a legal guardian may ask for access to, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of the child’s personal information, and may withdraw consent. The method and response time are the same as in “Your rights and how to exercise them” above. We ask only for the minimum information needed to confirm guardianship and delete it once confirmed.
  • If we learn that the personal information of a child under 14 has been processed without a legal guardian’s consent, we will promptly delete that information held by TeamCP.

Security measures for personal information

  • On-device storage: app records and settings are stored in the app-private storage that Android keeps separate for each app, and are not sent to servers operated by TeamCP except as described in this policy.
  • Encrypted transmission: information the app sends over the internet (ad requests, Google services, problem reports, online matches) is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
  • Report server access limits: the problem-report server accepts only reports in a fixed format sent by registered apps, and stores app authentication values as hashes, not as the original values. Administrative access to the server and database is limited to TeamCP’s operator account. Reports do not automatically include the advertising ID, account, or location.
  • Online match data: stored in TeamCP’s Firebase project through anonymous sign-in, without a name or email address; administrative access to the project is limited to TeamCP’s operator account.
  • Data minimization: we do not collect sign-ups, passwords, names, or phone numbers, which keeps the personal information held by TeamCP to a minimum.
  • Retention and deletion: problem reports are deleted 90 days after receipt, or earlier if you ask us to delete them.
  • Retention and deletion: online match data is kept as long as needed for online features and abuse prevention, and is deleted on request.
  • Inquiry emails are deleted once they are no longer needed after we have responded. Personal information is kept only as electronic files and is deleted when the retention period ends.
  • Security for information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google follows each provider’s policy.
